name: airprompt
description: Remote control interface for IDE/CLI terminals with voice dictation

scripts.start: nohup node server.js > /tmp/airprompt.log 2>&1 & echo "AirPrompt daemon started"
scripts.test: node --test test/unit/*.test.js && for f in test/unit/*.test.sh; do bash "$f" || exit 1; done && bash test/integration/run.sh
scripts.lint: for f in server.js public/client.js bin/install.js bin/lib/*.js src/providers/*.js src/hooks/*.js src/hooks/core/*.js src/*.js test/unit/*.test.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done

author: Farox
